adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, when building the stored reference object(s), the diff changes `credentialId` to `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly in the later block: `credentialId: result.credentialId ?? undefined`). Previously, non-calendar (e.g., video) references would preserve the creating credential via `result.credentialId` (or fallback), but after this change they will store `undefined`, losing that association in persisted references. This is a concrete behavioral regression visible in the diff (credentialId dropped for non-calendar types).
